title: Twilight Vale
wikitext:
[[Image:Twilight Vale.jpg|thumb|Twilight Vale]]
'''Twilight Vale''' is the name of the southern forests of [[Darkshore]]. Like the rest of Darkshore, the woods of the Twilight Vale are crawling with corrupted [[furbolg]]s, feral [[nightsaber]]s, and rabid [[bear]]s.  Travelers are advised to stick to the roads when traveling through the vale.
